ITAView Privacy Policy

Effective date: October 4, 2026

This policy describes ITAView 1.0.0, an offline image viewer for Mac. The app does not collect, upload, sell, or share personal data. It has no account system, advertising, analytics, tracking, telemetry, or network requests.

Files that you choose

ITAView reads images and folders that you choose. It uses image content, file names, and image dimensions on your Mac to display and browse images. Selecting one image does not automatically grant access to its entire folder. You can choose the containing folder to allow browsing of its other images.

The app uses macOS App Sandbox with read-only access to user-selected files. Image decoding and caching happen locally. ITAView does not modify your original images or send them to a server. It does not require access to contacts, location, the microphone, or the camera.

Original files and accounts

You control the original files on your Mac. ITAView has no server-side account data to delete because it does not operate an account service. File storage and synchronization that you configure outside ITAView remain under your control and the relevant service's settings.

Support correspondence

The Privacy Policy and Support links in the Help menu open your default web browser. The viewer itself makes no network requests. Website visits and email messages are external actions that you choose. Opening a link does not automatically send the images you view.

For support and privacy requests, use the public contact. If you send an email, the recipient receives your email address, message, and any attachments you choose to send. Email support is separate from the app's local image processing. Do not send private images or credentials with a support request.

This policy will be reviewed if a future version changes the app's data practices. The effective date identifies the published policy version.
